messages:
Elena (PM): quick sync  we need to finalize quota carryover rules and burst admission controls for dedicated pools before sending the Q3 product brief to sales. customers want clear predictability.
Noah (Eng): main decision: allow limited carryover credits vs strict daily window. carryover reduces customer anger but complicates scheduling.
Priyanka (SRE): ops perspective: prefer a capped carryover (e.g., 25% of committed quota) with decay to avoid long-term headroom erosion. also need admission caps per-tenant to avoid single-tenant storms.
Omar (Sales): customers ask for "burst carryover" so unused reserved capacity can be used later. they'd tolerate a cap. they also want a reporting export for billing reconciliation.
Zoe (Legal): require explicit contract language for carryover, esp. around billing and overage protections. also define notice window for admission throttles.
Noah (Eng): config sketch:
```
reserved_pools:
  carryover_enabled: true
  carryover_cap_pct: 25
  carryover_decay_days: 7
  per_tenant_admission_cap_per_min: 1200
  admission_policy: tiered # options: tiered|fifo|fairshare
```

Priyanka (SRE): instrumentation: carryover_used_pct, admission_denies, per_tenant_peak_rps, billing_export_ok. alert if pool occupancy > 90% and carryover_used_pct > 15%.
Elena (PM): launch checklist draft:
- carryover policy implemented + config defaults
- admission caps + fairshare fallback implemented
- billing export for finance
- contract appendix language from legal
- pilot with two customers (one wants carryover, one wants strict daily)
Noah (Eng): rough estimate: 3w policy + admission logic, 1w billing export, 1w QA/pilot = 5w.
Priyanka (SRE): 1w dashboards + alerts, and chaos test during pilot.
Omar (Sales): I'll line up pilot customers and prep expectation docs.
Zoe (Legal): I'll send draft clause by EOW referencing carryover_cap_pct and decay days.
quota-bot: created ticket CAP-5902: "quota-carryover + admission-cap pilot" assigned to @Noah. :page_with_curl:
Elena (PM): action items: Noah RFC, Priyanka dashboards, Zoe contract blurb, Omar pilot list. keep comments here or DM. :calendar:
